questionText: What is the opposite of 'benevolent'?
explanation: Malevolent is the opposite of benevolent - M-A-L-E-V-O-L-E-N-T. Benevolent means kind; malevolent means wishing evil.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'good'?
explanation: Best is the superlative of good - B-E-S-T. Good, better, best is the irregular comparative series.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'transparent'?
explanation: Opaque is the opposite of transparent - O-P-A-Q-U-E. Transparent means see-through; opaque means not allowing light through.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'far'?
explanation: Farthest is the superlative of far - F-A-R-T-H-E-S-T. Furthest is also correct for abstract distance.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'humble'?
explanation: Arrogant is the opposite of humble - A-R-R-O-G-A-N-T. Humble means modest; arrogant means excessively proud.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'bad'?
explanation: Worst is the superlative of bad - W-O-R-S-T. Bad, worse, worst is the irregular series.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'verbose'?
explanation: Concise, terse, and brief are all opposites of verbose - V-E-R-B-O-S-E. Verbose means using many words unnecessarily.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'little' (referring to amount)?
explanation: Least is the superlative of little (amount) - L-E-A-S-T. Fewest is used for countable nouns.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'obsolete'?
explanation: Current, modern, and contemporary are all opposites of obsolete - O-B-S-O-L-E-T-E. Obsolete means no longer in use.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'many'?
explanation: Most is the superlative of many - M-O-S-T. Many, more, most is the irregular series.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'affluent'?
explanation: Impoverished, destitute, and poor are all opposites of affluent - A-F-F-L-U-E-N-T. Affluent means wealthy.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'complex'?
explanation: Most complex is the superlative - C-O-M-P-L-E-X. Longer adjectives use most rather than -est.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'loquacious'?
explanation: Taciturn, quiet, and silent are all opposites of loquacious - L-O-Q-U-A-C-I-O-U-S. Loquacious means very talkative.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'efficient'?
explanation: Most efficient uses most for this longer adjective - E-F-F-I-C-I-E-N-T. Three-syllable adjectives use most.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'volatile'?
explanation: Stable, steady, and consistent are opposites of volatile - V-O-L-A-T-I-L-E. Volatile means likely to change rapidly.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'old' when referring to a family member?
explanation: Eldest is the preferred superlative for family members - E-L-D-E-S-T. Oldest is used in other contexts.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'elated'?
explanation: Despondent, sad, and depressed are all opposites of elated - E-L-A-T-E-D. Elated means very happy and excited.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'beautiful'?
explanation: Most beautiful is correct for this three-syllable adjective - B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L. Long adjectives use most.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'gregarious'?
explanation: Solitary, reserved, and introverted are all opposites of gregarious - G-R-E-G-A-R-I-O-U-S. Gregarious means fond of social company.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'near'?
explanation: Nearest is the superlative of near - N-E-A-R-E-S-T. Near, nearer, nearest.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'pedantic'?
explanation: Pragmatic and practical are opposites of pedantic - P-E-D-A-N-T-I-C. Pedantic means overly concerned with minor rules.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'funny'?
explanation: Funniest is the superlative of funny - F-U-N-N-I-E-S-T. Short adjectives ending in y change to iest.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'ephemeral'?
explanation: Permanent, eternal, and enduring are opposites of ephemeral - E-P-H-E-M-E-R-A-L. Ephemeral means lasting only briefly.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'hot'?
explanation: Hottest is the superlative of hot - H-O-T-T-E-S-T. CVC adjectives double the final consonant before -est.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'magnanimous'?
explanation: Petty, mean, and selfish are opposites of magnanimous - M-A-G-N-A-N-I-M-O-U-S. Magnanimous means generous in spirit.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'late'?
explanation: Latest and last are both superlatives of late - L-A-T-E. Latest means most recent; last means final in order.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'lucid'?
explanation: Obscure, vague, and murky are opposites of lucid - L-U-C-I-D. Lucid means clear and easy to understand.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'wise'?
explanation: Wisest is the superlative of wise - W-I-S-E-S-T. One-syllable adjectives typically use -est.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'tenacious'?
explanation: Yielding, submissive, and weak-willed are opposites of tenacious - T-E-N-A-C-I-O-U-S. Tenacious means holding firm.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'expensive'?
explanation: Most expensive is the superlative - E-X-P-E-N-S-I-V-E. Multi-syllable adjectives use most.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'ferocious'?
explanation: Gentle, tame, and docile are all opposites of ferocious - F-E-R-O-C-I-O-U-S. Ferocious means savagely fierce.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'capable'?
explanation: Most capable is the superlative - C-A-P-A-B-L-E. Most is used with three-syllable adjectives.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'prolific'?
explanation: Unproductive, barren, and sterile are opposites of prolific - P-R-O-L-I-F-I-C. Prolific means producing much.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'well' (as in to do well)?
explanation: Best is the superlative of well - B-E-S-T. Well, better, best is the irregular series for the adverb.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'redundant'?
explanation: Essential, necessary, and vital are opposites of redundant - R-E-D-U-N-D-A-N-T. Redundant means unnecessary or exceeding what is needed.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'much'?
explanation: Most is the superlative of much - M-O-S-T. Much, more, most is the irregular series.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'covert'?
explanation: Overt, open, and public are all opposites of covert - C-O-V-E-R-T. Covert means done in secret.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'big'?
explanation: Biggest is the superlative of big - B-I-G-G-E-S-T. CVC adjectives double the consonant before -est.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'diligent'?
explanation: Lazy, indolent, and lethargic are all opposites of diligent - D-I-L-I-G-E-N-T. Diligent means hardworking.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'early'?
explanation: Earliest is the superlative of early - E-A-R-L-I-E-S-T. Adjectives ending in y change to iest.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'candid'?
explanation: Evasive, deceptive, and secretive are all opposites of candid - C-A-N-D-I-D. Candid means openly honest.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'tall'?
explanation: Tallest is the superlative of tall - T-A-L-L-E-S-T. One-syllable adjectives use -est.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'austere'?
explanation: Lavish, luxurious, and opulent are opposites of austere - A-U-S-T-E-R-E. Austere means severe and simple.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'comfortable'?
explanation: Most comfortable uses most for this long adjective - C-O-M-F-O-R-T-A-B-L-E.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'ambiguous'?
explanation: Unambiguous, clear, and explicit are all opposites of ambiguous - A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S. Ambiguous means unclear or double-meaning.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'clever'?
explanation: Both cleverest and most clever are acceptable - C-L-E-V-E-R. Two-syllable adjectives may use either form.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'sincere'?
explanation: Insincere, deceitful, and hypocritical are all opposites of sincere - S-I-N-C-E-R-E. Sincere means genuine and truthful.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'thin'?
explanation: Thinnest is the superlative of thin - T-H-I-N-N-E-S-T. The n is doubled before -est in CVC adjectives.

questionText: What is the opposite of 'sanguine' (optimistic)?
explanation: Pessimistic, gloomy, and despondent are all opposites of sanguine - S-A-N-G-U-I-N-E. Sanguine means optimistic and positive.

questionText: What is the superlative form of 'quickly'?
explanation: Most quickly is the superlative adverb - Q-U-I-C-K-L-Y. Adverbs ending in -ly use most.
